subtitle: Open-Source Libraries, Frameworks & 3D Model Attributions (Sketchfab CC-BY)
content: 1. 3D MODELS & ASSETS (SKETCHFAB CC-BY ATTRIBUTION) We gratefully acknowledge and thank the talented artists of the global 3D community who make their work available under Creative Commons Attribution licenses on Sketchfab.com: • Vehicle Models & Automotive Props: Derived and adapted from various 3D models licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) and CC BY-NC 4.0 via Sketchfab. - All vehicle meshes were re-topologized, re-mapped, and optimized for mobile and PC real-time rendering. - In accordance with CC-BY licensing terms, no endorsement, sponsorship, or affiliation with the original creators is implied. - Full creator profiles, model titles, and original links are accessible at: sketchfab.com. • City Architecture, Environment & Street Props: Buildings, roadside obstacles, vegetation LODs, and urban furniture were provided or adapted from Sketchfab community creators under CC-BY licenses and public domain (CC0) asset repositories. • Character Apparel & Customization Accessories: Clothing meshes and headwear items were optimized from open Creative Commons models and the Unity Asset Store. --- 2. ENGINE, NETWORKING & OPEN-SOURCE FRAMEWORKS This game is proudly powered by industry-leading open-source libraries and engine modules: • Unity Engine & Universal Render Pipeline (URP): Copyright © Unity Technologies. High-performance shader models and scriptable render passes. • FishNet Networking Engine (v6.5): Developed by FirstGearGames. A high-performance, server-authoritative multiplayer networking framework for Unity (Dual/Commercial License). • Firebase SDK & Authentication: Copyright © Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. Secure player authentication and real-time database synchronizations. • TextMesh Pro & Cinemachine: Copyright © Unity Technologies. Advanced font rendering, SDF formatting, and procedural camera rigging. • Audio & Sound Effects: Vehicle engine sounds, tire screeches, ambient city soundscapes, and UI sound effects provided by contributors on Freesound.org and OpenGameArt.org under CC0 (Public Domain) and CC-BY 3.0.
